verdict.rationale: Microsoft's docs say Copilot Chat is available inside Teams and lets users interact securely with web and work data in natural language. However, nothing shows that natural-language commands can actually operate Teams, such as creating channels, scheduling meetings or changing settings. The agent-building toolkit, slash commands and prompt starters are developer building blocks for custom agents, so they earn no credit here. Missing for 10: documented natural-language control of Teams actions and settings, any detail on what Copilot in Teams can execute, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
